title: Devil's Work
subtitle: Sounds both gentle and harsh—the whispering wind and rustling grass.

items.text: Devil's Work
Thick, acrid smoke billows from the wreckage of the armored vehicle.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: *cough*
Marsha braces herself on a pile of debris, all at once letting herself feel the sharp tearing pain in her shoulder.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: It's over. Someone helped us.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Pa ... Paravyan, are you alright?
She looks across the road. Just ahead, the young man is pinned under a heavy beam.

items.speaker: "Officer"
items.text: Stay put, Marsha. You're bleeding.

items.speaker: "Officer"
items.text: I can ... I can get myself out.
Paravyan strains with all his strength but can't move the timber an inch.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: We're all clear. Let me help you.

items.speaker: "Officer"
items.text: Don't fuss over me. It's just a bit of wood. You need to stay put. Your head and shoulder are bleeding!

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: What? Am I hurt?
Marsha staggers to her feet.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Ugh, I'm feeling faint.
She reaches for the top of her head.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: It seems you're right. I'm bleeding profusely from several wounds. That's what I get for suppressing all my pain.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Ah so, just a little shrapnel. Nothing too serious.

items.speaker: "Officer"
items.text: Treat your wounds first, Marsha.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Understood.
She leans back on a pile of fallen bricks, her head swaying until it slumps.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: I'll be alright. I just need a little rest.
Her gaze lifts up to a pair of boots.
Then, the sizeable barrel of an anti-tank rifle.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Who ...
She looks up.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: You again ...
She struggles to her feet.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Sit.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Um ...
Her legs buckle, leaving her braced up against the debris.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: You saved us. Thank you.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: What brought you here?

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Collecting intel on Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Have you no reckoning on the danger in this place?
Marsha shakes her head.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Idiot. You might well have breathed your last in that battle.
Let go!

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Who's out there?
Sentinel turns, spotting a figure emerging from the armored vehicle's smoking shell.
Let me go! You're gonna get me killed!
At his feet lies a wounded soldier in the same black uniform.

items.speaker: Wounded Soldier
items.text: No! Sterling ... Please ...
The wounded man's cries are cut short. Sterling turns two manic bloodshot eyes toward the advancing sniper.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: F**k!
A bullet strikes the Gargoyle clean through her abdomen, but it draws no blood. Instead, chips of stony debris fall out from the wound.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: What the hell? You goddamn monster!
The man's eyes go wider still as he turns to flee.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Heh.
She does not give chase. She walks to Paravyan and lifts the beam from his body.

items.speaker: "Officer"
items.text: *cough*

items.speaker: "Officer"
items.text: Thanks. Who are you? Are you with the Foundation?
The young man finds his answer in her grim and stony face.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Stay here and tend to your comrade.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: I will tend to our enemies.
Windmill Plain

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: *panting*

items.speaker: Eugen
items.text: Are we the only ones left? Where's Kolten?

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Dead! Now get the lead out and run!

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: She's coming at us! She's coming! Shoot her, Eugen, shoot her!

items.speaker: Eugen
items.text: I ... I can't see her. Where are we running?

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Look, there's an old mill ahead! We'll regroup there to intercept her—keep running, you idiot!

items.speaker: Eugen
items.text: I see her now. She's there.

items.speaker: Eugen
items.text: Die!

items.speaker: Eugen
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: You idiot!

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Ugh. Ahhhh! My hand!
An old windmill lies just ahead—refuge, in his panicked mind.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Urgh ... Huff ...

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: For the wicked flee, and I pursueth.
Another bullet strikes her shoulder and glances off in another spray of stone.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Why won't you die? You devil!

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: A devil, you call me?

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: What are you, then?
What hast thou done? The voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: You who discord between nations and plot schemes for the undoing of man. Who then is your master?
She steps closer.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: For if you do the devil's work, are you not a devil like me? I pity you. Repent and you may yet find mercy in the judgment of the Lord.
And now art thou cursed from the earth,

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: What the hell do you want? Back off!

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Sterling, isn't it? You need not fear me. You still have time.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Ahhhhh!
Which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Repent, and you may yet be saved. Speak.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: What are you talking about? What do you want from me?
When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: *coughing*
The soldier tumbles to the ground; as he scrambles, he launches into a desperate prayer.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Answer me. For what purpose does Manus Vindictae drive the world to war and ruin?

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Mother of Resurrection, the Guiding One ...
The prayer follows a pattern she knows by heart, yet the name he speaks is strange.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: Please have mercy on your humble servant. I pray for a miracle—a ladder into your eternal kingdom.

items.speaker: Sterling
items.text: I hereby offer my life to you. Please save me from desperation and take me to the golden era.
A fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
He saves the last bullet for himself.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: A blasphemer to the end.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Ms. Sentinel!
